title: Observed Topology runtime explorer
description: Deliver the post-v0.4 observability-grade Runtime workspace defined in docs/specs/v0.5/11-observed-topology.md, beginning with an original ArchMap visual shell and synthetic observation fixture before live connectors.
completion_criteria: Stage O1 provides Runtime query controls, Observed Topology canvas, inspector, timeline rail, minimap, health rings, metric edge encoding, selection, and clustering over a synthetic fixture.
Stage O2 provides canonical observation records, streaming patches, deterministic aggregation, topology geometry caching, and 100/1000/10000 element benchmarks.
Stage O3 provides Design, Observed, and Diff reconciliation with provenance and no-data semantics.
Stage O4 proves the connector contract with OpenTelemetry data.
Stage O5 passes accessibility, export, security, large-graph, browser visual, and QIF acceptance.
success_criteria: The runtime map is immediately legible at operational information density and remains interactive under the documented performance budgets.
Users can pivot from observed behavior to authored architecture and lifecycle evidence without confusing observation with intent.
The product uses original ArchMap visual components and does not copy third-party branding, proprietary assets, or pixel-identical UI.
triage_notes: Do not start connector breadth first. Implement Stage O1 as a visual/product proof using deterministic synthetic data, then Stage O2 model/performance foundations. Keep current v0.4 lifecycle work releasable and isolated.
